objective: Discover a materially higher-turnover after-cost payoff by combining external Binance Futures price discovery with queue-aware passive Bybit entry, while retaining one global slot and strategy-defined exits only.

economic_thesis.information_advantage: A completed Binance Futures top-book and aggressor-flow shock can move the executable cross-venue fair value before Bybit BTCUSDT reprices.
economic_thesis.execution_advantage: Join the stale Bybit best quote post-only instead of paying taker cost at entry; abandon the order immediately when the external fair-value premise invalidates.
economic_thesis.payoff: A filled position exits at frozen fair-value catch-up or external-reference reversal. There is no elapsed-time liquidation.
economic_thesis.why_it_can_scale_growth: The information unit is sub-second, repeatable and potentially high-turnover; cost reduction occurs on every authorized entry rather than through leverage rescue.

event_definition.basis: prior-only 10-minute EWM of log Bybit/Binance executable mids, shifted one completed state
event_definition.direction: sign of the completed Binance shock and aligned fair-value gap
event_definition.frozen_target: 90% of the signal-time cross-venue fair-value gap
event_definition.reference_reversal: Binance executable mid returns through its pre-shock 500ms origin

execution_contract.signal_availability: signal bucket must complete before latency starts
execution_contract.order: one-sided Bybit post-only order at the last known best bid for long or best ask for short immediately before activation
execution_contract.post_only_validity: cancel if the displayed best quote leaves the frozen order price or would cross the opposite quote
execution_contract.queue_ahead: displayed best-quote size immediately before activation
execution_contract.fill: later opposing aggressive volume fills only after consuming initial displayed queue plus modeled order
execution_contract.ambiguous_trade_price_rule: count a 100ms bin only when every same-side trade in that bin executed at or through the order price
execution_contract.pending_cancel: fair-value gap decays below 25% of signal gap, Binance reference reverses, target is reached before fill, or top-quote identity is lost
execution_contract.filled_exit: fair-value catch-up or Binance reference reversal after one completed exit bucket plus 100ms exit latency
execution_contract.one_global_slot: pending and filled states occupy the slot; arbitration uses actual placement time

features: signed Binance and Bybit quote imbalance
Binance and Bybit one-second quote-update intensity

model.fill_calibration: one isotonic map fitted only on the calibration date
model.conditional_catchup_model: one HistGradientBoostingClassifier on filled training events
model.conditional_calibration: one isotonic map fitted only on filled calibration events
model.authorization: p_fill times conditional target/stop expectancy must exceed the selected round-trip cost by 2bp

account_contract.winner_removal: remove the largest positive 10% accepted event keys before global-slot arbitration and rerun the entire account
account_contract.funding: not opened in the initial sub-day fatal screen; a survivor must add actual Bybit funding before ranking

combined_decision.advance: Both 100ms and 300ms paths pass every frozen gate; then expand the unchanged information unit over additional pre-2024 dates and add actual funding before any ranking claim.
combined_decision.retire: Either latency path fails the economic/model gate after adequate samples, or the exact information unit is sub-cost or concentration-dependent. Do not tune adjacent thresholds, models, latency, queue participation, risk or leverage.
